/.title: rsmb
/.description: Personal site and portfolio of Robby Bryson — interactive data visualizations, geospatial projects, and web tools.

/about.title: About
/about.description: Robby Bryson — software developer and geospatial engineer based in St. Louis. Background in Azure Maps, federal GIS, and startups.

/projects.title: Projects
/projects.description: Interactive projects and data visualizations by Robby Bryson — flights, route converter, and more.

/posts.title: Posts
/posts.description: Writing about projects, trips, and other things I find interesting.

/projects/adv-atlas/map.title: ADV Atlas
/projects/adv-atlas/map.description: Explore motorcycle routes, filter trips by year, distance, days, or location, compare trip facts, and read ride reports with photographs and day maps.

/projects/ski-status/map.title: ski-status
/projects/ski-status/map.description: Compare North American ski areas by skiable terrain, vertical, lifts, trails, night skiing, and pass access.

/projects/pins-of-inaccessibility.title: Pins of Inaccessibility
/projects/pins-of-inaccessibility.description: Explore global interior pins and detailed U.S. counties on a 3D globe. Compare boundary distances, navigate geographic levels, and view terrain and nearby places.

/projects/pins-of-inaccessibility/map.title: Pins of Inaccessibility
/projects/pins-of-inaccessibility/map.description: Search country, province, and U.S. county interior pins. Compare radius circles, select a pin for location details, and move up through geographic levels.

/projects/through-routes.title: Through Routes
/projects/through-routes.description: Explore scored motorcycle roads, inspect elevation and hairpins, find scenic stops, and build or generate routes with GPX export.

/projects/flights.title: Flights
/projects/flights.description: Explore flight routes on a 3D globe. Filter by year, airport, airline, or country, compare distance and recorded flight time, and share the current view.

/projects/flights/map.title: Flights
/projects/flights/map.description: Explore flight routes on a 3D globe. Filter by year, airport, airline, or country, compare distance and recorded flight time, and share the current view.

/projects/anki-artisan.title: Anki Artisan
/projects/anki-artisan.description: Build Anki flashcards from iNaturalist observations, eBird regions, CSV files, and Wikipedia tables, with build previews and incremental exports.

/projects/bookend.title: Bookend
/projects/bookend.description: Track reading, explore award lists and five reading analytics views, organize personal lists, and try the public reading demo without an account.

/projects/temperature-records.title: U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records.description: Explore recent station records, observed county extremes, certified state extremes, and standing-record ages, with visible data freshness and coverage.

/projects/temperature-records/map.title: U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records/map.description: Filter recent station records by state, scope, and margin. Compare county and state extremes and standing-record ages with visible data freshness and coverage.

/projects/temperature-records/trends.title: Standing Record Ages — U.S. Temperature Records
/projects/temperature-records/trends.description: Explore when today’s standing county temperature extremes were set, including their age distribution and geographic patterns.

/projects/tornado-tracks.title: Tornado Tracks
/projects/tornado-tracks.description: Explore recorded tornado county segments from NOAA/NCEI StormEvents, with year, intensity, regional and state filters, density maps, and historical comparisons.

/projects/tornado-tracks/map.title: Tornado Tracks
/projects/tornado-tracks/map.description: Explore recorded tornado county segments, filter by year, intensity, region, or state, and compare reported paths, density, and historical trends.

/projects/route2gpx.title: route2gpx
/projects/route2gpx.description: Plan routes and convert GPS tracks to GPX, KML, GeoJSON, TCX, or CSV. Local file conversion, map previews, and batch GPX downloads.

/projects/aborg.title: aborg
/projects/aborg.description: A CLI tool to scan, organize, and manage audiobook file collections into an Audiobookshelf-compatible directory structure.

/projects/parc.title: parc
/projects/parc.description: A Python CLI for building a long-running archive of podcast feeds and episodes with resumable downloads, SQLite state, and local archive audits.

/projects/status-dashboard.title: Status Dashboard
/projects/status-dashboard.description: Monitor site health, AWS resources and costs, Amplify deployments, named GitHub Actions workflows, incidents, and events in an Ink terminal dashboard.
